exceptions.reason: A VS Code-shaped IDE: activity bar, tree, tab strip, editor and a dockable bottom panel (ui-design-guidelines.md §0: 1366x640 is the floor, not a ceiling). It does not claim to run on a 320px phone viewport, and the a11y-check.js reflow check has no per-repo exception hook (it is pushed unconditionally, outside excepted()) -- recorded here for the record, matching web-designer 0.107.1; a release still needs --skip-a11y-check to clear this one finding, noted in the release notes.
